outcome: Composite outcome (cesarean section, preeclampsia, macrosomia, large for gestational age birth weight, neonatal intensive care unit admission, need for phototherapy, neonatal hypoglycemia)
Large for gestational age birth weight rate
cohort: Women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who delivered at the Yitzhak Shamir Medical Center between 2006 and 2016
finding: No association was found between insulin requirements and a composite adverse outcome in women with GDM.
mod_finding: Women with higher insulin requirements had higher rates of cesarean section than those with lower insulin requirements.
